# Mozilla
> Mozilla is the not-for-profit organization behind Firefox and related privacy, security, developer, and internet health products.

Mozilla.org is the central hub for Mozilla’s products, mission, company information, contribution pathways, and links to its broader ecosystem including Firefox, MDN, Thunderbird, support, and developer resources.

## Products
- [Products](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/): Overview of Mozilla’s consumer products, services, and AI offerings.
- [Firefox Browsers](https://www.firefox.com/): Entry point for Firefox desktop, mobile, and related browser offerings.
- [Mozilla VPN](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/vpn/): VPN product page covering features, platforms, and privacy benefits.
- [Mozilla Monitor](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/monitor/): Data breach monitoring and personal information exposure alerts.
- [Firefox Relay](https://relay.firefox.com/): Email and phone masking service for privacy protection.
- [MDN Plus](https://developer.mozilla.org/plus): Premium MDN offering with enhanced developer learning tools.
- [Thunderbird](https://www.thunderbird.net/): Open-source email client and productivity platform.
- [Solo](https://soloist.ai/): AI website creation tool for small businesses and entrepreneurs.

## AI and Emerging Products
- [0DIN](https://0din.ai/): AI security and trust tooling from Mozilla’s product ecosystem.
- [Tabstack](https://tabstack.ai/): AI-powered tab and browsing workflow management product.
- [Mozilla.ai](https://www.mozilla.ai/): Mozilla’s hub for open-source and trustworthy artificial intelligence.
- [Mozilla Ventures](https://mozilla.vc/): Venture fund supporting mission-aligned startups and technologies.
- [Mozilla Ads](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/advertising/): Information about Mozilla’s privacy-minded advertising approach.

## About Mozilla
- [About Mozilla](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/about/): Overview of Mozilla’s organization, mission, and structure.
- [The Mozilla Manifesto](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/about/manifesto/): Principles describing Mozilla’s vision for the internet.
- [Leadership](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/about/leadership/): Profiles of Mozilla’s leadership team and executives.
- [Careers](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/careers/): Open roles and information about working at Mozilla.
- [Contact](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/contact/): Contact options for Mozilla teams and inquiries.
- [Security](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/): Security policies, practices, and reporting information.

## Community and Contribution
- [Get Involved](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/contribute/): Main contribution hub for volunteering and participating in Mozilla.
- [Product Help](https://support.mozilla.org/): Official support knowledge base and community help forums.
- [File a Bug](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/): Bug tracking system for Mozilla products and projects.
- [Localize Mozilla](https://pontoon.mozilla.org/): Translation platform for localizing Mozilla products and content.
- [Mozilla Foundation](https://www.mozillafoundation.org/): Nonprofit arm focused on internet health and trustworthy AI.
- [Press Center](https://blog.mozilla.org/category/mozilla/news/): Official Mozilla news, announcements, and press updates.

## Firefox and Browser Resources
- [Firefox Developer Edition](https://www.firefox.com/channel/desktop/developer/): Firefox build tailored for web developers and testing workflows.
- [Firefox Enterprise](https://www.firefox.com/browsers/enterprise/): Browser deployment and management resources for organizations.
- [Firefox Release Notes](https://www.firefox.com/firefox/149.0.2/releasenotes/): Release notes documenting changes, fixes, and updates in Firefox.
- [Firefox Browsers](https://www.firefox.com/): Main Firefox product site for downloads and browser information.
- [Tools](https://firefox-source-docs.mozilla.org/devtools-user/): Firefox DevTools user documentation for debugging and web development.

## Developer Resources
- [MDN Web Docs](https://developer.mozilla.org/): Core web platform documentation, tutorials, and references.
- [MDN Plus](https://developer.mozilla.org/plus): Subscription features for enhanced MDN learning and productivity.
- [Firefox Source Docs](https://firefox-source-docs.mozilla.org/): Technical documentation for Firefox source code and internals.
- [DevTools User Docs](https://firefox-source-docs.mozilla.org/devtools-user/): Documentation for Firefox’s built-in developer tools.
- [Bugzilla](https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/): Issue tracking for engineering, QA, and open-source collaboration.
- [Pontoon](https://pontoon.mozilla.org/): Localization infrastructure for Mozilla projects and websites.

## News and Content
- [Mozilla Blog](https://blog.mozilla.org/): Central blog for product news, policy, research, and company updates.
- [Mozilla News](https://blog.mozilla.org/category/mozilla/news/): News category covering official announcements and press materials.
- [Mozilla Foundation](https://www.mozillafoundation.org/): Articles and initiatives on internet health, advocacy, and AI.
- [Mozilla.ai](https://www.mozilla.ai/): Updates and resources related to Mozilla’s AI work.
- [Mozilla Ventures](https://mozilla.vc/): Portfolio and thesis content for Mozilla’s investment activities.

- [Bluesky (@firefox.com)](https://bsky.app/profile/firefox.com): Firefox’s Bluesky social profile.
- [Instagram (@mozilla)](https://www.instagram.com/mozilla/): Mozilla’s Instagram account.
- [LinkedIn (@mozilla-corporation)](https://www.linkedin.com/company/mozilla-corporation/): Mozilla’s LinkedIn company profile.
